welcome_note: Good conversations start with being yourself.
welcome_privacy: Your pace. Your boundaries. You can block or report at any time.
photos_empty: Add a photo that feels like you.
push_development_build: Remote push requires a physical device and an EAS/development build, not Expo Go.
push_project_mismatch: This app build and server use different Expo projects.
push_not_configured: Push is not configured on this server.
push_privacy: Optional match and message alerts use generic lock-screen text. Delivery can be delayed or duplicated; already queued alerts cannot be recalled after logout or blocking.
photo_received: Photo received. Its displayed status is confirmed by the server.
profile_photos: Photos (maximum 6). Save text edits before changing photos.
account_delete_confirm_desc: This permanently hides your profile, deactivates matches, revokes all sessions, and queues your photos and data for irreversible deletion. Enter your password to confirm.
account_delete_failed: Account deletion failed. Check your password and try again.
discoverability_paused: Discovery paused. You will not appear to new people.
brand_slogan: First move is yours. The rest is together.
intro: A thoughtful space for new connections. For adults 18 and older.
authPending: Registration and sign-in will be available in the next stage. No account is signed in.
pending: You are signed in. This feature will be added in a later stage.
unavailable: Cannot reach a ready API. Check the server and network, then retry.
age_notice: For adults 18+. Your date of birth stays private. This is not identity verification.
invalid_credentials: Unable to sign in. Check your credentials, verify your email, or try again after the lockout period.
invalid_code: This code is invalid or expired. Request a new email.
adult_required: You must be at least 18 and enter a valid date of birth.
refresh_conflict: Session changed. Please sign in again.
rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and retry.
request_failed: The request could not be completed. Please retry.
connection_error: Cannot confirm your session. Check your connection and retry.
email_accepted: If this request is eligible, an email will arrive. Check your inbox and spam folder.
verified: Email confirmed. You can now sign in.
password_reset: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
session_expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
storage_error: Secure storage is unavailable. Retry before signing in.
logout_local_only: Signed out locally. Server revocation was not confirmed. When online, sign in and use “Sign out all devices”.
profile_later: Profile editing will be added in Prompt 3.
profile_desiredGenders: Genders you want to meet (select explicitly)
profile_visible: Visible in discovery when complete and approved
profile_invalid: Check the required fields and selection limits.
profile_save_failed: Could not save. The profile may have changed; reload and retry.
profile_action_failed: Could not complete the action. Retry or reload your profile.
profile_complete: Profile complete with an approved photo.
profile_incomplete: Complete your profile and add at least one approved photo.
photo_rejected: Rejected — remove and choose another photo
photo_remove_confirm: Remove this photo? If it is first, the next photo takes its place.
photo_cancelled: Retry cancelled. Remove the incomplete slot, or it expires after one hour.
photo_permission_denied: Photo access denied. You can allow access in Settings or continue editing text.
photo_permission_limited: Only selected photos are available. Manage access in Settings if needed.
discovery_city: City (public; do not enter a street address)
discovery_rate_limited: Update limit reached. Try later; you can still remove your location.
discovery_save_failed: Could not save preferences. Reload and retry, or choose city mode.
location_notice: Location is optional. City mode works without permission. Only an approximate area is stored.
location_consent: Use location once while the app is open? The server rounds it to an approximate area. Other people see only a distance range. You can remove it at any time.
location_saved: Approximate area saved. Select distance mode and apply preferences to use it.
location_remove: Remove saved location and use city
location_denied: Location access denied. Enter your city instead, or change permission in Settings.
location_unavailable: Location is unavailable or the network failed. You can use your city instead.
discovery_profile_required: Complete your profile, enable visibility and add an approved photo to discover people.
discovery_empty: No eligible profiles for these preferences yet.
discovery_unavailable: Could not load profiles. Check your connection and retry.
discovery_changed: This page or profile has changed. Refresh to check current availability.
swipe_uncertain: The result is not confirmed yet. Your original decision is saved; check it again before another swipe.
swipe_rejected: This decision could not be accepted. The feed has been refreshed.
swipe_storage_failed: Private storage is unavailable. Restart the app to retry; swiping is paused.
city_placeholder: e.g. Tbilisi, Paris, New York, London…
messages_intro: When you have a match, your conversations will appear here.
viewed_you_empty: No one has viewed your profile yet.
you_viewed_empty: You have not viewed any profiles yet.
chat_unavailable: This conversation is no longer available.
chat_storage_failed: Private storage is unavailable. Restart to retry.
chat_send_failed: Not confirmed. Retry the same message.
safety_privacy: Reports and who blocked whom are private. Previously received content cannot be recalled.
safety_recent_note: The server attaches the selected message, or up to five recent incoming messages. History is not reopened.
safety_confirm_block: Block this account? Both sides lose discovery and chat access. Unblocking will not restore a match.
safety_confirm_unmatch: Permanently end this match? Chat will close and this pair cannot rematch in this MVP.
safety_confirm_unblock: Remove your block? Previous matches and conversations stay closed. Their block, if any, remains.
safety_failed: Could not save. Check your selection or try later.
safety_uncertain: Outcome unknown. Retry submits the same request.
push_permission_denied: Notifications are disabled in system settings. This installation has been deactivated.
push_failed: Notifications could not be updated. Check your connection and try again.
push_unavailable: This notification no longer opens an available conversation.
auth_otp_email_hint: Enter your email address to receive your 4-digit code
onboarding_name_subtitle: This name will be displayed on your profile.
onboarding_birthday_subtitle: For 18+ adults only. Your age will be shown on your profile.
onboarding_interested_title: Who would you like to meet?
onboarding_city_subtitle: Choose your city to discover connections nearby.
onboarding_photo_subtitle: At least 1 photo is required to complete your dating profile.
onboarding_goal_subtitle: Help potential matches understand your relationship goals.
onboarding_interests_subtitle: Select up to 5 interests to find common topics.
onboarding_bio_subtitle: Write a short note about yourself or what you love.
onboarding_bio_placeholder: A few words about your personality, passions, hobbies…
profile_photos_caption: First photo is your primary profile photo. Tap + to add or ✕ to remove.
profile_age_banner_desc: Date of birth was specified during registration (18+) and is kept private. It is used only to display your age.
profile_visible_active: Your profile is visible in discovery
profile_visible_hidden: Your profile is hidden from discovery
val_name_min: Display name must be at least 2 characters
val_name_max: Display name must not exceed 50 characters
